# pcd_networking_floatingip_associate (Resource)

Associates an existing floating IP with a port. Use this when the floating IP and the port are managed separately (e.g. the floating IP is pre-allocated); to allocate and associate in one step, use `pcd_networking_floatingip` with `port_id` instead. Deleting this resource disassociates the floating IP but does not delete it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-network"
}

resource "pcd_networking_subnet" "example" {
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  name       = "tf-example-subnet"
  cidr       = "10.0.0.0/24"
}

resource "pcd_networking_port" "example" {
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  name       = "tf-example-port"

  fixed_ip = [{
    subnet_id = pcd_networking_subnet.example.id
  }]
}

resource "pcd_networking_floatingip" "example" {
  pool = "external-net"
}

resource "pcd_networking_floatingip_associate" "example" {
  floating_ip_id = pcd_networking_floatingip.example.id
  port_id        = pcd_networking_port.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `floating_ip_id` (String) The ID of the floating IP to associate. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `port_id` (String) The ID of the port to associate the floating IP with.

### Optional

- `fixed_ip` (String) The specific fixed IP on the port to map to. Defaults to the port's first address.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The floating IP ID (same as `floating_ip_id`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_floatingip_associate.example <floating_ip_id>
```
